title: 摸摸开工

keys.prompt:
Make ONE precise production keyframe sheet of NINE sequential animation illustrations. EXACTLY 3 columns and 3 rows of 512x512 SQUARE cells, total 1536x1536; read row major. Invisible equal grid divisions, absolutely no written text, numbers, lettering, panel frames or gutters. Each cell has exactly the same fixed lens, solid opaque pure WHITE background, mild safe margins and fixed ground line. Draw the reference character(s) large, with the same recognizable face design, costume, hair and accessories across the 9 cells. Only characters requested in the story. Draw graphic chibi animation cels with clean shapes, not a close-up collage, no motion blur. Each cell must show a DIFFERENT complete acting pose. This is one story with a readable pay-off and reset, including hands, gaze and props. At small chat scale every pose reads. STORY: Nailü drowses at flower counter on the right with a single loose bouquet. X on left gently pats her head ONCE with one hand, removes hand. N perks up, instantly gathers the bouquet and cinches pink ribbon; presents it proudly, sets it below counter and relaxes.
NINE chronological drawings: 1) 0.00 s: Nailü drowses on the right, cheek in her left palm; her right hand rests beside one loose bouquet and pink ribbon. X stands left, both hands on the counter. 2) 0.55 s: X raises only the right hand above Nailü’s head, keeping the left hand planted; Nailü and the bouquet remain still. 3) 0.95 s: X’s right palm gently contacts Nailü’s crown for one pat; her sleepy eyes turn upward, both hands unchanged. 4) 1.30 s: X withdraws the right hand toward the counter; Nailü straightens brightly, left hand gathering the stems and right hand catching the ribbon. 5) 1.80 s: Nailü grips the gathered stems with her left hand and cinches a pink slip bow with her right; X rests both hands on the counter. 6) 2.50 s: Nailü proudly presents the single tied bouquet at chest height with both hands, smiling toward X; X watches with both hands resting. 7) 3.15 s: Nailü places the bouquet on a visible shelf below the counter, both hands still touching it and eyes following it; X remains still. 8) 3.90 s: Nailü returns the same bouquet to the countertop, left hand spreading its stems while her right pulls the slip bow open; X watches. 9) 4.65 s: Nailü relaxes, eyelids drooping and cheek hovering just above her raised left palm; her right hand rests beside the loose bouquet and ribbon, while X rests both hands.
Continuity: Keep the camera fixed and counter front open throughout the 4.8-second loop, tracking both characters’ hands and the same bouquet and ribbon as pose nine settles into the distinct, adjacent pose one. ATTACHMENT AUTHORITY: the left subject is directly illustrated from the real Bilibili official pack Xingtong 好欸好欸 and 对对对: use her squat round silver-grey bob shape, big angular silver side-swept bang, small loop-shaped crossing slim hairpins on the viewer-right, dark plum tapered ink, broad warm red cheeks, low-set eyes with lively lash detail, dark navy sleeves and white sailor collar with powder-blue trim. Closely follow the shape and color blocks in the small original stickers. Omit their printed writing and onomatopoeia. Do not use generic idol character design. Where the reference shows no pupils for a gag, preserve that deliberate feature in the nod; ordinary open eyes of Xingtong are blue. Nailü, whenever requested, uses the taupe, green, white-flower figure at RIGHT of the guide. Do not draw the attachment collage as a new scene. Nailü has exactly ONE brown HEART-SHAPED COWLICK attached to the top of the head. Hair flowers and green bang streak match the right-side guide; absolutely NO floating green wavy symbols above her head. Her eye direction and smiles vary with the scene.

No grids, numbering, words, motion trails, crossfades or double hands. The attached four rows give A, B, B, C. Create TWO successive micro-actions: top TWO rows are SIX evenly spaced DIFFERENT complete inbetween poses from the first reference A toward B, bottom TWO rows are SIX from B toward C. The six progress values in EACH block are about 10%,26%,42%,58%,74%,90%. Source extremes are supplied separately in the final GIF, so fill ALL cells with precision motion, never six identical drawings. Follow bright clean line art and maintain exact registration and hand identity; no autonomous camera shake. C = 0.95 s: X’s right palm gently contacts Nailü’s crown for one pat; her sleepy eyes turn upward, both hands unchanged.
